title: Kerala Opposition Leader Defends Helicopter Use and Lunch During Flood Review
summary: VD Satheesan, leader of the opposition in Kerala, defended his use of a helicopter and having lunch during a flood review meeting. He stated he had lunch at 3 pm and questioned why eating was an issue. Satheesan also called the controversy surrounding his meal 'disrespectful' and defended his helicopter trip.
summary_points: VD Satheesan, Kerala opposition leader, defended his actions during a flood review.
He stated he had lunch at 3 pm and questioned the criticism.
Satheesan called the controversy over his meal 'disrespectful'.
He also defended his use of a helicopter.
title_hi: केरल के विपक्षी नेता ने बाढ़ समीक्षा के दौरान हेलीकॉप्टर के उपयोग और भोजन का बचाव किया
summary_hi: केरल में विपक्ष के नेता वी.डी. सतीसन ने बाढ़ समीक्षा बैठक के दौरान हेलीकॉप्टर के उपयोग और दोपहर का भोजन करने का बचाव किया। उन्होंने कहा कि उन्होंने दोपहर 3 बजे भोजन किया था और सवाल किया कि क्या उन्हें खाना नहीं खाना चाहिए था। सतीसन ने अपने भोजन को लेकर हुए विवाद को 'अनादरपूर्ण' बताया और अपनी हेलीकॉप्टर यात्रा का भी बचाव किया।
